name: Poki
tagline: AGPL-3.0 local MCP server and terminal agent that lets Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client operate a real iPhone over USB — no jailbreak, no extra hardware — and remembers past tasks to replay them faster; it really sends and pays, so use a test device for risky flows

xSignals.text:
向大家介绍 POKI —— 一个能够真正接管并操控你 iPhone 的 iOS Agent

它可以运行在任何地方，支持通过多种方式随时调用：
• 信息 (iMessage)
• Telegram
• 终端 (Terminal)
• 原生 iOS App
